facts: intl formats and parses locale-aware dates, numbers, currencies, and messages. It is not a complete Flutter localization workflow.

en.label: Formatting package
en.name: intl
en.summary: Locale-aware dates, numbers, currency, and messages.
en.description: Published by dart.dev and used by gen_l10n. You still choose how UI strings are stored. Pick this when formatting is the need, not a full catalog runtime.
tradeOffs: Not a full Flutter localization workflow
You still choose how strings are stored
avoidWhen: You expected it to replace ARB or asset catalogs
